notes: Single-stage: join a line-items ledger with a returns ledger on (order_id, product_id), filter line items to an inclusive reporting period, aggregate per-product gross/returned/net revenue with unit tallies, and rank the top products. Hard floor: the join (first-in-file-order matching at the matched row's unit price), the period filter, malformed-row tallies, rounding, and revenue tie-breaking all change which products rank top. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (three inputs + join semantics), debugging_ambiguity (first-match rule), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (four hidden cases incl. boundary periods, empty range, exact ties, repeated pairs), quantitative_correctness (exact money values and rankings).
